evidence.observation: O2 rises from ~5 ppm baseline to 13.2 ppm during growth
Monotonic climb to 33.2 ppm over four consecutive events while Ar flow and pressure stay nominal
Flow steady at ~100 sccm, so rising O2 is not from purge gas loss
Temperature holding 750 °C at setpoint, heater power nominal
